title: Email-auth test site: Express server + SMTP-to-Mailpit + verify logic
acceptance_criteria: Node/Express site in its own folder with its own run command on a different port (e.g. 8890); README/run docs included

Sign-up on /join sends a REAL verification email via SMTP to Mailpit; account inactive until the link is clicked / code entered at /verify; login at /signin (deliberately unconventional, different paths)
Login before verification is rejected; after verification it succeeds and exposes a success signal (e.g. authed session + /me-style endpoint or profile)
SMTP target configurable via env (documented: how to point it at Mailpit from docker-compose); degrades with a clear error if SMTP is down
